Method of Attack: Injects malicious code through a compromised build process, piggybacking off certain functions called by sshd to gain access and introduce backdoor functionality.
Impacted Systems: Debian-based and Red Hat-based distributions running x86-64 systems with glibc
Attack Vector: Supply chain attack, targeting xz package for compromise
Indicators of Compromise: Excessive CPU usage by sshd process, 500 ms delay in connections
